title: Word 18 — On the Honor and Nobility of True Christians
attribution_note: Word 18 of 28 in the collection Short Moral-Instructive Words — see Word 1 for provenance.

pairs.en: But let us look, and set before the inner eyes of our souls, the honor and nobility of the Christian, that we may be zealous for it and diligently seek it. Open, then, the hearing of your souls, and listen to this word about true Christians.

sections.heading: Children of God, in communion with the Father and the Son

pairs.en: 2) True Christians have a close union and communion with the Father and with His Son, Jesus Christ. The apostle of Christ assures us of this, saying: *“Our fellowship is with the Father, and with His Son Jesus Christ”* [1 John 1:3]. You can see for yourselves how great this is. People count it a great thing to have friendship and fellowship with an earthly king; how incomparably greater an honor, then, to have communion and friendship with God, who is *“the King of kings and Lord of lords, dwelling in unapproachable light”* [1 Timothy 6:15–16]! O how surpassing are the goodness and love of God for mankind! See and behold, Christians, the nobility and dignity of the Christian: they have communion with God, the Great and Incomprehensible One. Lord, beyond all word and understanding has Your wondrous goodness and love for fallen and poor mankind been multiplied.

sections.heading: The soul as a living temple of God

pairs.en: O blessedness! O dignity! O nobility of the Christian soul! That beloved, beginningless, endless, all-good, and uncreated Being — God — chooses rather to dwell in the holy Christian soul than in heaven or in any other temple. O all-good and beloved God, our Maker and Creator! Come and visit our afflicted souls — souls created by You in Your image and likeness!

sections.heading: Members of Christ, the exalted Head

pairs.en: 4) True Christians are the spiritual members of the heavenly Head — Christ, the King of kings and Lord of lords. The apostle speaks of this: *“We are members of His body, of His flesh and of His bones”* [Ephesians 5:30]. Holy Christian souls, lift up your eyes and see: where does your Head sit? At the right hand of God, in the glory of the Father. By whom is He honored and worshiped? By angels and archangels, and by all the heavenly powers and all creatures. *“Therefore God also has highly exalted Him and given Him the name which is above every name, that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, and of those on earth, and of those under the earth”* [Philippians 2:9–10]. You are the spiritual members of this exalted Head. When the Head is glorified, its members share in that glory too. Behold the glory of true Christians, behold their nobility and dignity! They are spiritual members of the exalted Head, Jesus Christ.

sections.heading: Betrothed as bride, and heirs of God

pairs.en: 6) True Christians are heirs of God, *“and joint heirs with Christ”* [Romans 8:17]; to them belong the eternal and heavenly kingdom and all its blessings: *“eye has not seen, nor ear heard, nor have entered into the heart of man the things which God has prepared for those who love Him”* [1 Corinthians 2:9].

sections.heading: The true nobility to be sought

pairs.en: O you who seek the vain glory of this world, who boast and exalt yourselves in your rank, your names, and your titles! Turn the inner eyes of your souls to the glory and nobility of the Christian, and seek that, so that you may be truly noble and glorious! The glory of true Christians is not visible now, but is perceived and known only by faith. It will be revealed at the revelation of the children of God. *“Beloved,”* says the apostle, *“now we are children of God; and it has not yet been revealed what we shall be, but we know that when He is revealed, we shall be like Him”* [1 John 3:2]. *“Then the righteous will shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father.* *He who has ears to hear, let him hear!”* [Matthew 13:43] Amen.
